difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of formal algebraic spaces over S, the lemma asserts the existence of a continuous functor Y_{spaces,etale} -> X_{spaces,etale} inducing a morphism of sites f_{spaces,etale}, that this assignment is compatible with compositions, and that the induced morphism of topoi f_small on the small etale topoi is likewise compatible with compositions (statement lines 7418-7438). The proof identifies the one point that is not inherited verbatim from the algebraic-space case: f induces a morphism of reductions X_red -> Y_red, so that the whole statement follows from the corresponding functoriality lemma for morphisms of algebraic spaces (proof lines 7440-7445). The level is H2: the argument is short, but it does more than cite -- it isolates the reduction that makes the algebraic-space statement applicable and is the only step where formal algebraic spaces require an argument.
